name: ferret-certified-loss-aware-conversions
instr:
Ferret cannot report semantic losses during conversion or reject inexact results. Add opt-in checked conversions across runtime, FQL, and compatibility APIs without changing ordinary conversions.

The package `github.com/MontFerret/ferret/v2/pkg/runtime` must export `ConversionLoss`, `ConversionMode`, `ModeExact`, `ConversionCertificate`, `ConversionCertificate.Exact`, `LossyConversionError`, `IsLossyConversion`, `ConvertChecked`, `ToDurationChecked`, `ToDateTimeChecked`, `ToDateTimeEpochChecked`, `ToIntChecked`, `ToFloatChecked`, `ToNumberChecked`, and `ToStringChecked`. Define `ConversionLoss` as an int with `LossRepresentation = iota`, `LossPrecision`, `LossStructure`, and `LossProjection`. Define `ConversionMode` as an int with `ModePermissive = iota` and `ModeExact`, where `ModeExact` equals 1. `(c ConversionCertificate) Exact() bool` means no loss. `IsLossyConversion(err error) bool` identifies only exact-mode loss rejection.

Checked conversions return the established value, actual types, and all deduplicated losses, including recursive ones. Exact mode rejects any loss with `LossyConversionError`, retaining its certificate and original public cause. Preserve fallible values' failure identity and ownership.

Preserve existing parsing, rendering, ranges, aliases, identity, projection, aggregation, fallbacks, error suppression, and unsupported arities. Duration distinguishes identity and integral units from fractional truncation, List unwrapping, and representation chang
